senses.gloss: to take someone into police custody
senses.example: Police arrested the suspect near the station.

senses.gloss: to stop or slow the development of something
senses.example: The new policy helped arrest the decline in sales.

translations.ja_JP: 阻止する; 抑制する

example_translations.zh_TW: 新政策有助於遏止銷售下滑。
